description: This file implements a TensorFlow-based object detector for Android, specifically designed for the MultiBox detection approach. It loads a model, processes images, runs inference, and outputs detected objects with bounding boxes and scores.

classes.name: TensorFlowMultiBoxDetector
classes.description: Main class implementing an object detection model using TensorFlow inference for Android devices. Manages model loading, image preprocessing, inference execution, and results postprocessing.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Factory method to instantiate and initialize the detector with model and configuration files.

methods.name: recognizeImage
methods.description: Processes a Bitmap image, runs object detection inference, and returns a list of recognition results with confidence scores and bounding boxes.

methods.name: enableStatLogging
methods.description: Enables or disables logging of inference statistics.

methods.name: getStatString
methods.description: Returns a string containing inference performance statistics.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Releases resources associated with the inference interface.
